overview.about: The Sao Paulo Grand Prix - long known as the Brazilian Grand Prix - is one of Formula 1's great racing venues, held at the short, anti-clockwise Interlagos circuit since 1973. Its bumpy surface, elevation changes and unpredictable weather produce chaos and championship deciders, and the passionate Brazilian crowd made heroes of Senna, Piquet and Massa. Alain Prost's six wins lead the all-time list. The 2026 race is on 6-8 November.
overview.nextEvent: The 2026 Sao Paulo Grand Prix runs 6-8 November at Interlagos, one of the few anti-clockwise tracks on the calendar and a favourite of drivers and fans alike. A sprint-weekend format and frequent rain make it one of the hardest races to predict.

@graph.description: The São Paulo Grand Prix is held at Autódromo José Carlos Pace, commonly known as Interlagos, in São Paulo. The circuit first hosted the Brazilian Grand Prix in 1973 and its undulating layout, changing weather and compact lap regularly make it one of Formula 1’s most tactically variable weekends. The existing OneSliders page provides the edition date through Event JSON-LD; this data keeps that local source rather than substituting a predicted date. Formula 1 weekends are organised around practice, qualifying and the Grand Prix, with any sprint-session details determined by the official championship timetable.
